sections.heading: Core Concepts: Comparing linear and exponential relationships

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 4x + 6$ in comparing linear and exponential relationships, evaluate $f(2)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 4x + 3 = 0$.
A data set recorded for comparing linear and exponential relationships consists of the four values $\{17, 21, 25, 31\}$. What is the arithmetic mean?
questions.answer: The sum is $17 + 21 + 25 + 31 = 94$, and dividing by $4$ gives $23.5$.
